topic: Querying facility name and ad address fields
summary_markdown: Someone inquired about discrepancies in reporting data for the Transit XL Network. Specifically, they noted that this network uses `user_frame_id` instead of the expected `master_facility_name`, unlike other networks (though Park Station XL was acknowledged as an exception). They also questioned the inclusion and purpose of a new column labeled 'Adress' in the campaign reports.
action_items: Someone will forward the issue to a specialized chat for resolution by Nina.
